gen-fs-quilon-gf-hedvig-letters-serif: Sturdy, tall-bodied lowercase with open-ended curves gives this text serif an authoritative, settled look. Hedvig Letters Serif is the quiet strength of the pair, because Quilon's editorial swagger above it never has to compete.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-kadwa: Quilon sets an editorial, commanding tone with a stroke that swells and thins in a slow, steady rhythm. Kadwa, a text serif, simply gets on with being readable.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-marcellus-sc: Quilon leads with a commanding, editorial stroke that rises and falls in a slow tide. Marcellus SC, a text serif, brings a dignified, literary stature, its lowercase carrying the weight of cast iron capitals.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-montagu-slab: Refined, traditional lowercase gives the body its footing, with robust downstrokes and slender turns. Montagu Slab would sink under a tiny Quilon heading, since that display face needs room to show its commanding presence.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-noto-serif-hentaigana: Quilon brings an editorial, commanding voice, its strokes swelling and easing while its counters stay generous. Noto Serif Hentaigana follows, refined and traditional.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla keeps its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals. Over a long stretch that serif feels refined and authoritative, its opened e keeping each line clear while Quilon's measured strokes stay up top.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-pridi: Pridi is a classic, refined serif with small letters standing proud. Its strongest quality is generous space around every curve, which lets Quilon's commanding strokes above it stand out all the more.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-scope-one: A slight swell on the bowls gives Quilon its editorial, commanding presence up top. And Scope One, a text serif, answers underneath with spilling counters and stubby ascenders beside a big x-height.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-slabo-13px: Slabo 13px reads in a bookish, dignified way, with clear openings in its rounded letters and a generous feel throughout. Quilon is best at commanding attention with a restrained thick-thin rhythm; the body simply carries the text.
gen-fs-quilon-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum stands tall, its x-height reaching high like a squared-off woodblock letter. Over a longer passage this text serif stays dignified and editorial, a sturdy partner for Quilon's quiet stroke modulation.
